request_summary: Coordinate the approved GEC Poste/AFM ordering fix and one full DEV rerun.

actions.description: Reviewed the engineer's GEC step diff and confirmed the requested Poste setup was already scoped to the declaring scenarios with cleanup in the scenario hook.
Delegated one approved fix-04 run, inspected the console evidence and confirmed the before_all secret-resolution failure prevented all scenarios from running.
Assessed README impact for the step-only assertion change; no reader-facing update is required.

outcome.detail: The code change was integrated and one run was attempted, but verification is blocked by unresolved DEV secret configuration; no further run was authorized.

notes: The fix-04 slot is reserved under the five-attempt policy; this run does not establish a test-code failure or pass.
